## Madrid Beginner Course Shortlist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg

For a **1-adult beginner course in Madrid** from **2026-09-07 to 2026-09-18**, morning classes, and a **max budget of EUR 700**, the best fit is usually a **short intensive Spanish program** with small groups, beginner placement, and a clear weekly schedule.

## What to Look for in Course Options
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/check2-circle.svg

- **Schedule fit:** Morning classes only, ideally **Mon–Fri** with start times around 9:00–10:00.
- **Beginner support:** Accepts **absolute beginners (A0/A1)** and includes placement or beginner intake.
- **Course length:** Programs that can cover **2 weeks** or allow **pro-rated enrollment** for your exact dates.
- **Budget clarity:** Tuition, registration fee, materials, and any exam/certificate fees should stay within **EUR 700 total**.
- **Class size:** Smaller groups usually give faster speaking practice.
- **Location:** Central Madrid or easy Metro access to reduce commute time.
- **Included extras:** Some schools include conversation sessions, online materials, or a certificate.
- **Flexibility:** Ask whether missed classes can be made up or whether late arrival is allowed on the first day.

## Program Comparison Scorecard
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

| Criterion | Weight | What good looks like | Score guide |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Schedule match | 30% | Morning-only classes during your dates | 0–5 |
| Beginner suitability | 25% | True A0/A1 intake, clear beginner syllabus | 0–5 |
| Total cost | 20% | All-in price at or below EUR 700 | 0–5 |
| Class quality | 15% | Small groups, qualified teachers, good reviews | 0–5 |
| Convenience | 10% | Central location, easy transport, flexible policies | 0–5 |

### How to score each school
- **5** = Excellent match
- **4** = Strong match
- **3** = Acceptable with minor trade-offs
- **2** = Weak fit
- **1** = Poor fit
- **0** = Does not meet the requirement

### Final score formula
- **Total score =**
  `(Schedule × 0.30) + (Beginner × 0.25) + (Cost × 0.20) + (Quality × 0.15) + (Convenience × 0.10)`

### Recommended decision rule
- **18–20 points:** Strong shortlist candidate
- **15–17 points:** Consider if price or timing is especially good
- **Below 15 points:** Usually skip

## Sample Inquiry Email to Schools
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/phone.svg

**Subject:** Spanish beginner course inquiry for 7–18 September 2026

Dear Admissions Team,

I am looking for a **Spanish beginner course in Madrid** for **1 adult** from **7 September 2026 to 18 September 2026**. I prefer **morning classes** and my maximum budget is **EUR 700**.

Could you please confirm:
- Whether you have **beginner-level** classes available for those dates
- The **morning schedule** and number of class hours per week
- The **total cost**, including registration and materials
- The **class size**
- Whether a **certificate** is included
- Your **placement process** for absolute beginners
- Any **cancellation or change policy**

If you have suitable options, please send me the course details and the next steps to enroll.

Kind regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Email]
[Your Phone Number]
